title: Turkish Revani with Prawn Skewers
description: A unique fusion of Turkish flavors with the sweetness of revani and the succulence of prawns. Perfect for a summer evening or a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the prawns onto skewers, leaving a little space between each prawn.
Brush the prawns with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the prawns for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, cut the revani into small squares.
Once the prawns are cooked, serve them on top of the revani squares.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
